scholarships.name: American Dream Scholarship for Nurses
scholarships.description: A $3,000 no-essay award for students pursuing a nursing degree. No essay required — apply with a free Bold.org profile.

scholarships.name: American Dream Scholarship for Practical Nurses
scholarships.description: A $1,500 no-essay award for students pursuing practical/vocational nursing (LPN/LVN). No essay required — apply with a free Bold.org profile.

scholarships.name: Diversity in Music Education Scholarship
scholarships.description: A $2,000 no-essay award supporting diversity among future music educators. No essay required — apply with a free Bold.org profile.

scholarships.name: InnovateHERs Scholarship Challenge
scholarships.description: A no-essay award for women driving innovation in their fields. No essay required — apply with a free Bold.org profile.

scholarships.name: Lucas Jeffery STEAM Scholarship
scholarships.description: A no-essay award for students pursuing STEAM (science, technology, engineering, arts, math). No essay required — apply with a free Bold.org profile.

scholarships.name: Flinn Scholarship
scholarships.description: A merit scholarship valued at more than $135,000 covering tuition, fees, housing, meals, and study abroad for about 20 Arizona high school seniors attending ASU, NAU, or the University of Arizona.

scholarships.name: Dorrance Scholarship
scholarships.description: A renewable award of $12,000 for first-generation Arizona high school seniors with financial need attending one of the state's public universities.

scholarships.name: Arizona Community Foundation General Scholarship Application
scholarships.description: A single ACF application matches Arizona students to dozens of donor-funded scholarships across the state. Scholarships typically open in January with March 1 and May 1 deadlines.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation for Southern Arizona Scholarships
scholarships.description: One application considers Southern Arizona students for multiple CFSA donor scholarships. Applications open in early January and close in February.

scholarships.name: ACF Yavapai County Cash for College Scholarships
scholarships.organization: Arizona Community Foundation of Yavapai County
scholarships.description: Locally funded scholarships for Yavapai County students, awarded through the Arizona Community Foundation regional office. Applications open January 1 and close in mid-March.

scholarships.name: ACF Yuma County Merit Scholarship
scholarships.description: Merit-based scholarships for Yuma-area students administered by the Arizona Community Foundation. Applications open January 1 and close in April.

scholarships.name: Nina Mason Pulliam Legacy Scholars Program
scholarships.organization: Nina Mason Pulliam Charitable Trust / Maricopa Community Colleges & ASU
scholarships.description: Long-term need-based support covering full tuition, fees, books, and a living stipend for adult students with dependents or those who have experienced foster care, attending ASU or a Maricopa Community College.

scholarships.name: Chicanos Por La Causa Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarships of up to $5,000 for up to four years for first-generation Latino students attending Arizona's three state universities or Maricopa Community Colleges.

scholarships.name: AZHCC Emerging Business Leaders Initiative (EBLI) Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Arizona Hispanic Chamber of Commerce Foundation
scholarships.description: Renewable scholarships for Hispanic-heritage students pursuing a business degree at an accredited Arizona university, with six $5,000 awards given annually to incoming juniors.

scholarships.name: Ed Pastor Scholarship Fund
scholarships.organization: Arizona Hispanic Chamber of Commerce Foundation
scholarships.description: The AZHCC awards one or more scholarships totaling about $15,000 a year through the Ed Pastor Scholarship Fund to Hispanic students in Arizona.

scholarships.name: Guarantee Your Future with Freeport
scholarships.description: Full scholarship support for students earning an A.A.S. degree and industry certification in select career pathways at designated Arizona community colleges, including help with housing, food, and transportation.

scholarships.name: Freeport-McMoRan Native American Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: Scholarships of up to $6,000 per year plus mentoring and student-success support for Native American students in Arizona pursuing higher education.

scholarships.name: El Valle Puede Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Phoenix Suns/Phoenix Mercury Foundation & Helios Education Foundation
scholarships.description: Renewable awards of up to $12,500 per year for Latino Arizona high school seniors with financial need attending an accredited postsecondary institution.

scholarships.name: TheDream.US National Scholarship (University of Arizona partner)
scholarships.description: Provides up to $33,000 toward a bachelor's degree for undocumented immigrant students (with or without DACA or TPS) who came to the U.S. before age 16, attending partner institutions including the University of Arizona.

scholarships.name: Office of Navajo Nation Scholarship & Financial Assistance
scholarships.description: Need-based financial assistance for enrolled members of the Navajo Nation admitted to accredited postsecondary institutions. The winter/spring term application closes November 25.

scholarships.name: Earn to Learn Matched Savings Scholarship
scholarships.description: A need-based matched-savings program: students who save $500 receive $4,000 in matching scholarship funds toward tuition, books, and expenses at an Arizona public university, plus financial literacy training.

scholarships.name: Beaty Martinez Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: A merit- and need-based award of up to $10,000 for Arizona high school seniors accepted to an in-state college or university, split between fall and spring semesters.

scholarships.name: Arizona Scholars Program (Deloitte Foundation)
scholarships.description: Five $5,000 scholarships for graduating Arizona high school seniors participating in the O'Connor Institute Ambassadors Civics and Debate Club, judged on academics, leadership, and civic knowledge.

scholarships.name: Arizona BPW Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Arizona Business and Professional Women's Foundation
scholarships.description: Scholarships for Arizona women age 19 and older returning to an Arizona community college to improve job prospects or advance their careers.

scholarships.name: Arizona Elk Society Youth Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarships for Arizona high school seniors pursuing a degree in wildlife sciences or closely related fields who demonstrate commitment to wildlife and the outdoors.

scholarships.name: Arizona National Livestock Show Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarships for students who participated in the Arizona National Livestock Show or Horse Show as exhibitors, contestants, volunteers, or interns for at least two years, pursuing college or trade school.

scholarships.name: Arizona Nursery Association Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarships of $500 to $3,000 for students pursuing horticulture, plant science, and related fields tied to Arizona's nursery and landscape industry.

scholarships.name: Maricopa County Farm Bureau Scholarship
scholarships.description: County Farm Bureau scholarships supporting Maricopa County students pursuing agriculture-related degrees and careers.

scholarships.name: Yuma County Farm Bureau Scholarship
scholarships.description: County Farm Bureau scholarships supporting Yuma County students pursuing agriculture-related degrees and careers.

scholarships.name: Scottsdale Rotary Club Scholarship
scholarships.description: Annual scholarships for graduating seniors at the five Scottsdale Unified School District high schools, awarded across nine achievement categories plus the Norval O. Tyler Scholarship.

scholarships.name: Gila River Indian Community Higher Education Scholarship
scholarships.description: Higher education scholarships for enrolled members of the Gila River Indian Community pursuing a bachelor's degree.

scholarships.name: Salt River Pima-Maricopa Higher Education Scholarship
scholarships.description: Higher education funding for enrolled members of the Salt River Pima-Maricopa Indian Community admitted to accredited colleges, universities, or vocational schools.

scholarships.name: President Barack Obama Scholars Program
scholarships.description: Covers tuition and fees, with possible additional funding for housing, meals, books, and supplies, for Pell-eligible Arizona resident students who demonstrate leadership.

scholarships.name: Arizona Assurance Program
scholarships.description: A financial aid program covering tuition and fees for low-income Arizona resident students, filling the gap after federal and state grants.

scholarships.name: NAU Access2Excellence
scholarships.description: Guarantees full undergraduate tuition coverage for Arizona residents with household income of $65,000 or less and for members of Arizona's 22 federally recognized tribes.

scholarships.name: ASU Leadership Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: Recognizes about 23 outstanding Arizona high school graduating seniors (plus up to two out-of-state) who have achieved excellence in leadership, providing a renewable scholarship at ASU.

scholarships.name: Cal Grant A
scholarships.amountLabel: Up to full systemwide tuition and fees
scholarships.description: State entitlement grant that pays systemwide tuition and fees for financially eligible California residents attending a qualifying UC, CSU, or private/independent college. Requires a verified GPA and a FAFSA or California Dream Act Application.

scholarships.name: Cal Grant B
scholarships.amountLabel: $1,672 access award (plus tuition after year one)
scholarships.description: State grant for low-income California residents that provides an access award for living costs and books in the first year, then adds tuition and fee coverage in later years. Requires a verified GPA and FAFSA or California Dream Act Application.

scholarships.name: Middle Class Scholarship
scholarships.description: State scholarship for undergraduates at a UC, CSU, or select community college baccalaureate program, for families with household income and assets up to $250,000. No separate application; awarded via timely FAFSA or CADAA.

scholarships.name: Silicon Valley Community Foundation Managed Scholarships
scholarships.description: A portfolio of nearly 700 scholarships totaling over $4.5 million each year, primarily for current or former residents of San Mateo, Santa Clara, and San Francisco counties. Applicants complete one general application to be matched to eligible funds.

scholarships.name: Community Scholarship (Sacramento Region)
scholarships.description: General scholarship for graduating high school seniors from a Sacramento County high school planning to attend a two-year, four-year, vocational, or trade school. One general application recommends matching funds.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation for Monterey County Scholarships
scholarships.description: Scholarship program for students with ties to Monterey County pursuing higher education, awarded through a single online application that matches applicants to multiple funds.

scholarships.name: Imperial Valley Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Scholarships for Imperial County students pursuing college or vocational education, administered through the foundation's annual scholarship cycle.

scholarships.name: San Diego Foundation Common Scholarship Application
scholarships.description: A single application giving San Diego County students access to more than 150 scholarship opportunities, with awards ranging from $1,000 to more than $5,000 and some renewable for multiple years.

scholarships.name: ACUMEN Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship supporting East Bay students pursuing higher education, administered by the East Bay Community Foundation through its scholarship portal.

scholarships.name: CIELO Fund Scholars Program
scholarships.description: Scholarship program investing in Latino students attending Inland Empire colleges and universities, run through the CIELO Fund at the Inland Empire Community Foundation.

scholarships.name: Hispanic Education Endowment Fund (HEEF) Scholarships
scholarships.description: Scholarships for Orange County Latino and Hispanic students pursuing higher education, awarded annually to a competitive pool of applicants.

scholarships.name: California Latino Legislative Caucus Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: Statewide scholarship established to provide financial assistance to deserving California residents, with an emphasis on students from underserved communities.

scholarships.name: Edison Scholars Program
scholarships.description: Awards $50,000 college scholarships to 30 high school seniors in Southern California Edison's service area who plan to attend a four-year college and pursue a STEM major. Applicants must demonstrate financial need.

scholarships.name: SoCalGas Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: Up to fifteen $5,000-per-year scholarships (up to $20,000 over four years) for high school seniors in the SoCalGas service territory who plan to study a STEM, finance, or accounting field and demonstrate financial need.

scholarships.name: PG&E Employee Resource Group Scholarships
scholarships.description: More than $300,000 in scholarships funded by PG&E employee resource groups for college-bound high schoolers and current college students whose primary residence is in PG&E's Northern and Central California service area.

scholarships.name: California Wine Grape Growers Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: Six scholarships each year for high school seniors whose parent or legal guardian is employed by a California winegrape grower: $8,000 for a UC or CSU four-year program or $2,000 for a California community college.

scholarships.name: Sons of Italy Western Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Order Sons and Daughters of Italy in America, Western Foundation
scholarships.description: Scholarships for graduating California high school seniors of full or partial Italian descent enrolling in an accredited college, university, community college, or trade school, including academic, Italian language, and career education awards.

scholarships.name: Sal Castro Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: A $1,000 scholarship for CLYLP alumni interested in a career related to education, honoring educator and activist Sal Castro.

scholarships.name: CIF Scholar-Athlete of the Year
scholarships.description: Statewide award honoring two graduating California high school student-athletes (one male, one female) with a $10,000 scholarship; twenty section winners each receive $1,500. Students are nominated through their CIF section rather than applying directly.

scholarships.name: TheDream.US National Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for undocumented immigrant students (with or without DACA or TPS) who came to the U.S. before age 16, providing up to $16,500 for an associate degree and up to $33,000 for a bachelor's degree at partner colleges, several of which are in California.

scholarships.name: California Teachers Association Scholarship for Members
scholarships.description: Up to ten $3,000 scholarships for active CTA members demonstrating high academic achievement, with separate awards available for dependent children of members and Student CTA members.

scholarships.name: Scholarship Foundation of Santa Barbara General Scholarship
scholarships.description: Need-based scholarships for Santa Barbara County students who attended county schools, averaging about $3,512 for four-year undergraduates and renewable for up to five years of undergraduate study.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation Sonoma County Scholarships
scholarships.description: More than 35 legacy and new scholarship funds for Sonoma County students seeking financial assistance for post-secondary, graduate, or professional education, administered in partnership with 10,000 Degrees.

scholarships.name: California Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: One of the largest scholarship managers in Los Angeles, administering more than 150 scholarship programs and awarding over $3 million annually to students in Los Angeles County and beyond seeking postsecondary education and workforce training.

scholarships.name: 10,000 Degrees General Scholarship
scholarships.description: Need-based scholarship of $1,500 for residents of Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, Santa Clara, San Mateo, or Sonoma counties pursuing an associate or bachelor's degree, with mentorship and alumni support included.

scholarships.name: California Restaurant Foundation General Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarships of up to $4,000 a year for California high school seniors and undergraduates pursuing the restaurant, foodservice, and hospitality industries, including culinary arts, hospitality management, and food science.

scholarships.name: California Grocers Association Educational Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarships for California grocery industry employees and their family members who are high school seniors or already enrolled in higher education, with more than $800,000 in funds offered for the program year.

scholarships.name: Rotary Club of Palo Alto Scholarships
scholarships.description: Up to ten scholarships typically ranging from $1,000 to $3,000 for full-time students connected to the Palo Alto community, awarded on academics, service, and need.

scholarships.name: Rotary Club of Ignacio Scholarships
scholarships.description: Five $2,000 scholarships for graduating high school seniors from Novato-area high schools, awarded by the Rotary Club of Ignacio.

scholarships.name: Belmont Redwood Shores Rotary Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Rotary Club of Belmont and Redwood Shores
scholarships.description: Scholarships for local high school seniors judged on academic achievement, community service, and financial need, awarded by the Belmont Redwood Shores Rotary Club.

scholarships.name: Cooke Undergraduate Transfer Scholarship
scholarships.description: Last-dollar scholarship of up to $55,000 per year for high-achieving community college students transferring to a four-year institution, plus advising and a scholar network. California community college students are among the largest cohorts of recipients.

scholarships.name: Hispanic Scholarship Fund (HSF) Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarships of $500 to $5,000 for students of Hispanic heritage, along with support services, mentorship, and career resources. HSF has a large California applicant and partner base.

scholarships.name: MALDEF Law School Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Mexican American Legal Defense and Educational Fund
scholarships.description: Scholarships of $2,000 to $10,000 for law students at accredited U.S. law schools who demonstrate a commitment to advancing Latino civil rights, evaluated on academics, activities, background, and financial need.

scholarships.name: Asian Pacific Community Fund Scholarships
scholarships.description: A portfolio of scholarships (17 programs) for high school seniors and college students in Southern California, with awards up to $20,000, serving Asian American and Pacific Islander communities.

scholarships.name: Real Estate Education Endowment Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarships of $600 per semester for California community college students enrolled in real estate courses, funded through the state Real Estate Education Endowment with a total of $60,000 available for the year.

scholarships.name: Kern Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Scholarships for Kern County students pursuing higher education, awarded through the foundation's annual application window in late spring and early summer.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation Santa Cruz County Scholarships
scholarships.description: Scholarships for Santa Cruz County students pursuing college, university, or vocational education, awarded through a single application that matches students to multiple funds.

scholarships.name: Horatio Alger California Scholarship
scholarships.description: State-specific scholarship for California high school seniors who have faced and overcome significant adversity, demonstrate critical financial need, and are committed to pursuing higher education.

scholarships.name: SAG-AFTRA Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: The John L. Dales and George Heller Scholarship competitions provide funds for eligible SAG-AFTRA members and their dependents to study at accredited colleges, trade schools, and certificate programs.

scholarships.name: Lompoc Rotary Club Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarships for high school seniors connected to the Lompoc community who plan to attend a vocational school, community college, or four-year college in the coming academic year.

scholarships.name: Florida Bright Futures - Florida Academic Scholars (FAS)
scholarships.organization: Florida Office of Student Financial Assistance
scholarships.description: Florida's top Bright Futures award covering 100% of tuition and applicable fees at eligible Florida public institutions for high-achieving graduates. Requires a 3.5 weighted GPA, qualifying test scores, and 100 service hours.

scholarships.name: Florida Bright Futures - Florida Medallion Scholars (FMS)
scholarships.organization: Florida Office of Student Financial Assistance
scholarships.description: The second Bright Futures tier covering 75% of tuition and applicable fees at eligible Florida institutions. Requires a 3.0 weighted GPA, qualifying test scores, and 75 service hours.

scholarships.name: Benacquisto Scholarship Program
scholarships.organization: Florida Office of Student Financial Assistance
scholarships.description: State award for National Merit Scholars who attend an eligible Florida institution, equal to the in-state cost of attendance minus Bright Futures and the National Merit award. No separate application is required.

scholarships.name: First Generation Matching Grant Program
scholarships.organization: Florida Office of Student Financial Assistance
scholarships.description: Need-based state grant for Florida undergraduates who are the first in their family to attend college, funded by state dollars matched by participating Florida institutions. Award amount is set by each school.

scholarships.name: Minority Teacher Education Scholarship
scholarships.description: A $4,000 per year award ($2,000 per semester) for Florida-resident minority juniors in a state-approved educator preparation program. Recipients agree to teach one year in a Florida public school per year of funding.

scholarships.name: Florida Engineering Society High School Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Florida Engineering Society / Florida Engineering Foundation
scholarships.description: Merit scholarship for Florida high school seniors planning to study engineering, requiring a 3.5 GPA, qualifying test scores, and U.S. citizenship or permanent residency. The 2026-2027 application posts in December.

scholarships.name: FES Henn Rebane Scholarship
scholarships.description: Named FES university scholarship of $1,000 with preference for electrical engineering students who are Florida residents, awarded through the general FES university application.

scholarships.name: Florida Engineering Foundation (FEE) Scholarship
scholarships.description: A $1,000 scholarship for engineering sophomores through seniors at Florida institutions with a minimum 2.75 GPA, awarded by the Florida Engineering Foundation.

scholarships.name: FES FECON Construction Engineering Scholarship
scholarships.description: A $1,000 award for engineering juniors and seniors with a 3.0 GPA and a construction focus, offered through the Florida Engineering Society.

scholarships.name: Florida Sheriffs Association Scholarship
scholarships.description: Ten scholarships of $2,000 per year each in criminal justice and in STEM fields for children of full-time Florida sheriffs' office employees pursuing a related degree.

scholarships.name: Future Lawyers Scholarship
scholarships.description: A $5,000 annual award for up to three years for Miami-Dade or Broward County residents admitted as first-year students to an ABA-accredited law school.

scholarships.name: Kozyak Summer Fellowship Fund
scholarships.description: A $5,000 fellowship for minority and first-generation law students attending Florida law schools, or Florida residents attending law school elsewhere.

scholarships.name: HACCOF Scholarship Grant
scholarships.organization: Haitian-American Chamber of Commerce of Florida
scholarships.description: A $2,500 tuition award for first-generation college students who have lived in Miami-Dade County for at least one year, are ages 17 to 26, and are pursuing a business or public sciences degree.

scholarships.name: Juan Ramon Guerrero Scholarship
scholarships.description: A $10,000 annual scholarship for undergraduate or graduate students studying finance or a related field who show evidence of support for the LGBTQ community.

scholarships.name: Byron M. Morris Scholarship
scholarships.organization: The Community Foundation for Northeast Florida
scholarships.description: A $4,800 award paid $1,200 per year for four years for an Eagle Scout or Girl Scout Gold Award recipient with a 3.0 or higher GPA enrolling full time.

scholarships.name: Craig Speziale Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.organization: The Community Foundation for Northeast Florida
scholarships.description: A $3,000 scholarship for a Ponte Vedra High School graduate with a 3.4 or higher unweighted GPA.

scholarships.name: Dorothea B. Shaw Scholarship
scholarships.organization: The Community Foundation for Northeast Florida
scholarships.description: An $8,000 award paid $2,000 per year for four years for a Duval County student with a 3.0 or higher GPA attending a Northeastern U.S. institution.

scholarships.name: James Thomas Pickren Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.organization: The Community Foundation for Northeast Florida
scholarships.description: A $3,070 scholarship for a Stanton College Preparatory School student-athlete who has demonstrated leadership.

scholarships.name: Leslie Baker Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.organization: The Community Foundation for Northeast Florida
scholarships.description: A $2,250 scholarship for a Sandalwood High School cross country athlete with a 3.0 or higher GPA.

scholarships.name: Sam and Lydia Payne Scholarship
scholarships.organization: The Community Foundation for Northeast Florida
scholarships.description: Up to $12,000 paid $3,000 per year for four years for a North Florida student with a 2.2 to 3.5 weighted GPA. Three awards are given.

scholarships.name: Talen Charles Birt Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.organization: The Community Foundation for Northeast Florida
scholarships.description: Up to $2,000 for a graduating senior from Andrew Jackson, First Coast, Jean Ribault, or William M. Raines High School in Jacksonville.

scholarships.name: Cole Kelly Scholarship
scholarships.organization: The Community Foundation for Northeast Florida
scholarships.description: A $4,000 scholarship for a Ponte Vedra High School graduate with a 3.0 or higher weighted GPA who demonstrates a Christian commitment.

scholarships.name: Elizabeth Edgar Hall Founders Scholarship
scholarships.organization: The Community Foundation for Northeast Florida
scholarships.description: Up to $6,000 paid $2,000 per year for three years for a female undergraduate at Edward Waters University, Jacksonville University, or the University of North Florida who is completing her first year.

scholarships.name: Della M. Levy Scholarship for Graduate Studies
scholarships.organization: The Community Foundation for Northeast Florida
scholarships.description: A $4,500 scholarship for a female graduate student enrolled full time at Jacksonville University or the University of North Florida.

scholarships.name: Bernie G. Yvon Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Bernie Yvon Scholarship Fund (via Community Foundation for Northeast Florida)
scholarships.description: Up to $2,000 for high school seniors and college students in theatre or performing arts with a 2.8 or higher GPA.

scholarships.name: College Fund of Pinellas County Grant
scholarships.description: A need-based grant of $1,200 per year (up to $4,800 over four years) for Pell-eligible Pinellas County graduating seniors who remain enrolled full time and academically eligible.

scholarships.name: Pinellas Rising Stars Scholarship
scholarships.description: Arts scholarships of $500 to $5,000 awarded to top finishers in categories including culinary, dance, instrumental music, theater, visual arts, and vocal performance for Pinellas County students.

scholarships.name: Pinellas Traditional Senior Scholarship
scholarships.description: A single application giving Pinellas County graduating seniors access to 120-plus scholarship opportunities ranging from $500 to $20,000, awarded from more than $700,000 annually.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation Tampa Bay Common Scholarship
scholarships.description: A single common application unlocking 25-plus scholarship funds for students from Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, Hernando, and Citrus counties, including seniors, college students, and returning adults.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation for Palm Beach and Martin Counties Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Community Foundation for Palm Beach and Martin Counties
scholarships.description: A scholarship program for Palm Beach and Martin County students that awarded 178 scholarships totaling $1.7 million, averaging about $10,000 each, for college and vocational study.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation of Sarasota County Scholarship
scholarships.description: A single application accessing 97 scholarship funds for residents or high school graduates of Sarasota, Manatee, Charlotte, or DeSoto County, which distributed more than $2.1 million across 636 awards.

scholarships.name: Excelsior Scholarship
scholarships.organization: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
scholarships.description: Tuition-free attendance at SUNY or CUNY two- or four-year colleges for full-time New York students whose household federal adjusted gross income is $125,000 or less. Students must complete 30 credits per year and live and work in New York after graduation for the length of the award.

scholarships.name: NYS Scholarships for Academic Excellence
scholarships.organization: New York State Education Department / HESC
scholarships.description: Merit award for New York's top high school graduates based on Regents exam scores; 8,000 awards a year (2,000 of $1,500 and 6,000 of $500). Recipients must attend a college or university in New York State.

scholarships.name: NYS Achievement and Investment in Merit Scholarship (NY-AIMS)
scholarships.organization: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
scholarships.description: A $500 merit scholarship for New York high school graduates who earn a Regents diploma with honors or score 3 or higher on two or more AP exams and enroll full-time at a New York college or university.

scholarships.name: NYS Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) Incentive Program
scholarships.organization: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
scholarships.description: Full SUNY or CUNY tuition for students in the top 10 percent of their New York high school class who pursue an approved STEM degree at a SUNY or CUNY college and agree to work in a STEM field in New York State for five years after graduation.

scholarships.name: NYS Math and Science Teaching Initiative Scholarship
scholarships.organization: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
scholarships.description: Covers the cost of tuition for undergraduate or graduate students who commit to teaching math or science in a New York secondary school (grades 7-12) for at least five years after certification.

scholarships.name: New York State Opportunity Promise Scholarship
scholarships.organization: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
scholarships.description: Free community college tuition for New York residents ages 25 to 55 with no prior college degree who enroll at least half-time in a high-demand associate degree program and complete it within 10 semesters.

scholarships.name: New York State Aid to Native Americans
scholarships.organization: New York State Education Department, Native American Education Unit
scholarships.description: State aid of up to $2,000 a year (about $85 per credit part-time) for enrolled members of a New York State tribe, or their children, who attend a college in New York State.

scholarships.name: New York State World Trade Center Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.organization: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
scholarships.description: Covers tuition, fees and living expenses for up to four years of full-time undergraduate study for the children, spouses and financial dependents of those killed or severely disabled in the September 11, 2001 attacks and related rescue and recovery efforts.

scholarships.name: New York State Memorial Scholarship for Families of Deceased Firefighters, Police Officers, Peace Officers and EMS Workers
scholarships.organization: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
scholarships.description: Covers tuition and non-tuition costs such as room, board, books and transportation for the children and spouses of New York firefighters, police officers, peace officers, and emergency medical service workers who died in the line of duty.

scholarships.name: New York State Veterans Tuition Award
scholarships.organization: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
scholarships.description: Tuition award for eligible New York veterans pursuing full-time or part-time undergraduate, graduate or approved vocational study at a New York State institution.

scholarships.name: New York State Military Service Recognition Scholarship (MERIT)
scholarships.organization: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
scholarships.amountLabel: Up to full cost of attendance
scholarships.description: Provides up to the full cost of attendance for children, spouses and financial dependents of members of the U.S. armed forces or state militia who, while New York residents, died or became severely and permanently disabled in hostilities or training on or after August 2, 1990.

scholarships.name: Flight 3407 Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.organization: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
scholarships.description: Financial aid for the children, spouses and financial dependents of individuals killed in the February 12, 2009 crash of Continental Airlines Flight 3407 near Buffalo, for full-time study at a New York State institution.

scholarships.name: Empire State Arts Scholarship Program
scholarships.organization: New York State Education Department, Office of Cultural Education
scholarships.description: Awards up to $2,000 covering tuition for New York State students in grades 6-12 with demonstrated economic need to attend New York-based summer programs in dance, music, visual arts, media arts, or theatre.

scholarships.name: New York State Tuition Assistance Program (TAP)
scholarships.organization: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
scholarships.description: New York's largest need-based grant, giving eligible full-time and part-time New York residents up to $5,665 a year toward tuition at approved New York colleges. Does not need to be repaid.

scholarships.name: TeachNY Scholarship
scholarships.description: A $1,000 scholarship for future teachers pursuing first-time New York teacher certification through a partner program, with regional awards targeting NYC, rural areas and the state's 'Big Five' urban districts.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation for Greater Buffalo Scholarships
scholarships.description: A single online application opens dozens of scholarships for residents of the eight counties of Western New York, with awards typically from $1,000 to $6,000 and preference for Pell-eligible students attending school in Western New York.

scholarships.name: Rochester Area Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: A consolidated application covering 55+ scholarships (of 125+ total funds) for Rochester-area residents, spanning college, technical and trade programs. Award notifications go out by June 1.

scholarships.name: Central New York Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: A single universal scholarship application covering the foundation's many funds for students in the greater Central New York (Syracuse-area) region.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation for the Greater Capital Region Scholarships
scholarships.organization: Community Foundation for the Greater Capital Region
scholarships.description: Over 30 named scholarships through one universal application for students in the Capital Region (Albany, Rensselaer, Saratoga, Schenectady and surrounding counties). Applications reopen each December.

scholarships.name: Chautauqua Region Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Awards more than $1 million a year through a combined application covering 175+ scholarship opportunities for graduating seniors and college students from the Chautauqua County region of Western New York.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation of Orange, Sullivan and Rockland Scholarships
scholarships.organization: Community Foundation of Orange, Sullivan and Rockland (CFOSR)
scholarships.description: Scholarships for students in Orange, Sullivan and Rockland counties covering skilled trades, agriculture, arts, technology and public service, accessed through a universal eligibility application plus per-scholarship applications.

scholarships.name: Northern New York Community Foundation Freshman & Named Scholarships
scholarships.description: Scholarships for high school seniors and college students in Jefferson, Lewis and St. Lawrence counties entering two- or four-year colleges, trade or vocational schools, applied for through the foundation's universal application.

scholarships.name: Ernie Davis Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Community Foundation of Elmira-Corning and the Finger Lakes
scholarships.description: Awarded to a student who exhibits the integrity, leadership, courage and humility of Elmira's Ernie Davis, with preference for student athletes, drawn from five Elmira-Corning area high schools. Requires 44 volunteer hours or an Ernie Davis awareness project.

scholarships.name: Ascend Educational Fund Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarships of $2,500 to $20,000 for immigrant students and children of immigrants graduating from a New York City high school, regardless of ethnicity, national origin or immigration status. Recipients also receive mentoring.

scholarships.name: NYWEA N.G. Kaul Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: One of NYWEA's statewide scholarships (over $50,000 awarded a year) for New York students in environmentally focused degree programs; the N.G. Kaul Memorial award is $5,000.

scholarships.name: New York State Grange Agriculture Scholarship
scholarships.description: Two $1,000 scholarships a year for New York State residents majoring in a field of agriculture at an accredited two- or four-year college.

scholarships.name: NYS Association of Agricultural Fairs / Showpeople's Association Scholarship
scholarships.organization: New York State Association of Agricultural Fairs (NYSAAF)
scholarships.description: Up to ten $1,500 scholarships plus additional $500 awards for New York State residents who are or have been active in a member county fair and plan to attend college.

scholarships.name: NYSUT Retiree Council 7 Scholarship
scholarships.organization: New York State United Teachers (NYSUT) Retiree Council 7
scholarships.description: A $2,000 scholarship for a New York high school student whose parent or grandparent is a member of NYSUT Retiree Council 7 (Central New York) and who plans to pursue education to become a teacher.

scholarships.name: New York State Elks Association Scholarship
scholarships.description: $1,000 scholarships for children and stepchildren of New York State Elks members in good standing; open to high school seniors and current college students, filed through the sponsoring local lodge.

scholarships.name: New York Women in Communications Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.organization: New York Women in Communications (NYWICI) Foundation
scholarships.description: Scholarships of $2,500, $5,000 or $10,000 for students in communications-related fields (advertising, journalism, marketing, PR, film, digital media and more) who live or attend school in the greater New York metropolitan area.

scholarships.name: Kaplan Leadership Program Scholarship
scholarships.description: Intensive scholarship and transfer-support program for low-income community college students in the New York/New Jersey area aiming to transfer to selective four-year schools; includes $3,000 toward tuition plus a monthly stipend and application funding.

scholarships.name: Rotary Club of Saratoga Springs Scholarships
scholarships.description: About a dozen scholarships a year, ranging from $2,500 to $20,000 over four years, for college- and trade-school-bound seniors living in or graduating from a high school within the Saratoga Springs City School District.

scholarships.name: New York Conference of Italian American State Legislators Scholarship
scholarships.organization: New York Conference of Italian American State Legislators (NYIACSL)
scholarships.description: $3,000 scholarships (two academic and two athletic per participating district) for New York high school seniors and college students with an 85+ GPA who are active in community service; applicants need not be of Italian American heritage.

scholarships.name: Ronald McDonald House Charities New York Tri-State Area Scholarships
scholarships.organization: Ronald McDonald House Charities of the New York Tri-State Area
scholarships.description: Scholarships for graduating high school seniors under 21 in the New York Tri-State area, including general and community-specific awards (African American Future Achievers, HACER for Hispanic students, and Asian-Pacific Students Increasing Achievement).

scholarships.name: Excellence in Accounting Scholarship (Moynihan)
scholarships.description: Scholarship for accounting students accepted to or enrolled in a four-year New York State college or university with at least a 3.0 GPA, sponsored by the education foundation of the New York State Society of CPAs.

scholarships.name: Amsterdam Rotary Club Service Above Self Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Rotary Club of Amsterdam, New York
scholarships.description: Annual Service Above Self scholarships, including a $1,500 first-place award and nine $500 runner-up awards, for graduating seniors from high schools throughout Montgomery County, New York.

scholarships.name: New York Farm Bureau Agricultural Youth Scholarship
scholarships.description: For New York graduating high school seniors preparing for an agriculture-connected career; the state first-place winner receives $3,000, second place $2,000, and each district winner $250. Free student Farm Bureau membership is required.

scholarships.name: Pennsylvania State Grant (PA State Grant)
scholarships.description: A need-based state grant for Pennsylvania residents attending approved postsecondary schools; the FAFSA plus the PA State Grant Form serve as the application. The 2026-27 maximum full-time award is $2,744 per semester.

scholarships.name: Grow PA Scholarship Grant
scholarships.description: Grants for Pennsylvania residents who study for an in-demand occupation at a PA school and agree to live and work in Pennsylvania in that field after graduating. Awards are first-come, first-served for up to four years.

scholarships.name: Pennsylvania Chafee Education and Training Grant
scholarships.organization: PHEAA / PA Department of Human Services
scholarships.description: A federally funded grant administered by PHEAA that helps current and former foster youth pay for postsecondary education and training. Maximum award is $5,000 per academic year, subject to cost of attendance.

scholarships.name: Postsecondary Educational Gratuity Program (PEGP)
scholarships.description: Waives tuition, fees, and on-campus room and board (after other aid) at public PA institutions for children of Pennsylvania police, firefighters, rescue/ambulance members, corrections staff, or National Guard/military who died in the line of duty.

scholarships.name: Pennsylvania Targeted Industry Program (PA-TIP)
scholarships.description: Need-based awards for Pennsylvania residents enrolled in shorter-term (10 weeks to under two years) programs in targeted fields: energy, health, advanced materials and diversified manufacturing, and agriculture/food production.

scholarships.name: The Pittsburgh Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: A single online application matches students to roughly 375 donor-established scholarship funds, awarding nearly $3 million annually to graduating seniors, undergraduates, and graduate students in the greater Pittsburgh/western PA region.

scholarships.name: Philadelphia Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Over 200 scholarships (up to $5,000) for graduating high school seniors in the Greater Philadelphia region who demonstrate unmet financial need via FAFSA, through one common application.

scholarships.name: Berks County Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: One universal application automatically matches Berks County students to 130+ scholarship funds for graduating seniors, current college students, and lifelong learners.

scholarships.name: Lancaster County Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: General and school-specific scholarship funds for Lancaster County students pursuing higher education, applied for through the Foundation's online scholarship program.

scholarships.name: The Erie Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: One GOapply application covers all scholarship funds for students in the Erie, PA region pursuing full-time undergraduate study at accredited schools; most awards share an April deadline.

scholarships.name: Lehigh Valley Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Scholarship and award funds for high school seniors and community college students in Lehigh, Northampton, and Bucks counties, applied for through the Foundation's online portal.

scholarships.name: Centre Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Centre County (State College area) scholarship funds awarded through a single online application that matches students to funds they qualify for.

scholarships.name: York County Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Field-of-study and Dollars for Scholars funds for York County graduating seniors; some are applied for online, others through the student's home school district.

scholarships.name: Scranton Area Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Over 60 scholarships for graduating high school seniors and current college students in the Lackawanna/Scranton region, applied for through one SACF Common Application.

scholarships.name: Community Giving Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Scholarship funds for students in the Central Susquehanna Valley region, applied for through a single online submission before the April deadline.

scholarships.name: Chester County Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Scholarship funds primarily for graduating Chester County high school seniors pursuing college, community college, or technical school, applied for online or via school guidance offices.

scholarships.name: First Community Foundation Partnership of PA Scholarships
scholarships.organization: First Community Foundation Partnership of Pennsylvania (Williamsport)
scholarships.description: Over 135 scholarships totaling more than $410,000 (ranging $200 to $20,000) for high school and non-traditional students in north-central PA, applied for through FCFP's online grant portal.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation for the Alleghenies Scholarships
scholarships.description: Scholarship funds for residents of Bedford, Cambria, Indiana, and Somerset counties, PA; most are selected through committees at local high schools.

scholarships.name: Bucks County Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Over 60 scholarships (~$400,000 total) for Bucks County students heading to college or trade school, awarded via one universal application judged on academics, service, leadership, character, and need.

scholarships.name: Adams County Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: More than 100 local scholarships for graduating Adams County high school seniors pursuing trade school, certificate programs, or college, matched through a single online profile.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation of Westmoreland County Scholarships
scholarships.description: Westmoreland County scholarship funds administered alongside The Pittsburgh Foundation's scholarship system, applied for through one online application.

scholarships.name: The Montgomery County Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.organization: The Montgomery County Foundation, Inc. (Blue Bell, PA)
scholarships.description: Scholarships for Montgomery County, PA residents (typically one-year residency) who are high school seniors or recent graduates enrolling at accredited colleges, based on need and merit.

scholarships.name: POISE Foundation General Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarships supporting African American students who reside in Allegheny County and are accepted or enrolled at a two- or four-year college, university, or trade/technical school. Spring and fall cycles each award several scholarships.

scholarships.name: The Pittsburgh Promise Scholarship
scholarships.description: A last-dollar scholarship of up to $5,000 per year (up to $20,000 total) for Pittsburgh Public Schools graduates who have been city residents and enrolled since 9th grade, usable at any accredited PA college, university, or trade school.

scholarships.name: Eleanor Friedberg Art Scholarship Fund
scholarships.organization: The Pittsburgh Foundation / Manchester Craftsmen's Guild
scholarships.description: For graduating high school seniors at Pittsburgh Public Schools or charter schools in Wilkinsburg, Homestead, Duquesne, or West Mifflin who plan to pursue a certificate, associate, or bachelor's degree in art.

scholarships.name: HBA of Pennsylvania Legal Education Fund (LEF) Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarships for Latino law students attending law schools in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, or Delaware, awarded annually and recognized at the Fund's fall scholarship banquet.

scholarships.name: Bunton-Waller Award
scholarships.description: A merit- and need-based award for incoming first-year Penn State students with strong academics and high financial need; renewable up to four years with a 2.5 GPA.

scholarships.name: The GIANT Company Scholarship for Rising Juniors
scholarships.description: A no-essay merit scholarship (up to $1,000) for full-time college sophomores with a 3.0+ GPA attending a Pennsylvania State System of Higher Education (PASSHE) school; preference to GIANT team members and dependents.

scholarships.name: PSECU Scholarship
scholarships.description: Annual scholarships awarding $2,000 per year for up to four years ($8,000 total) to graduating high school seniors who are PSECU members attending a two- or four-year school.

scholarships.name: American Legion Department of PA High School Oratorical Contest
scholarships.organization: The American Legion, Department of Pennsylvania
scholarships.description: A speech competition for Pennsylvania students in grades 9-12 on the U.S. Constitution; the state Department winner receives $7,500 (runners-up $5,000 and $4,000), with additional national scholarships for advancing.

scholarships.name: Farm Credit Foundation for Agricultural Advancement Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Farm Credit Foundation for Agricultural Advancement (Horizon Farm Credit)
scholarships.description: Scholarships of up to $10,000 for high school seniors and current college students in Horizon Farm Credit's territory (including Pennsylvania) who plan to pursue a career in agriculture; renewable up to four times.

scholarships.name: Temple University Academic Merit Scholarships
scholarships.description: Automatic, renewable merit scholarships of $3,000 to $10,000 for Pennsylvania-resident incoming freshmen; all admitted students are considered with no separate application if they apply by the Feb. 1 admission deadline.

scholarships.name: Temple Promise
scholarships.description: A last-dollar program covering remaining tuition and mandatory fees for Philadelphia residents who graduate high school and enroll full-time at Temple with a family adjusted gross income of $65,000 or less.

scholarships.name: Pennsylvania Engineering Foundation (PEF) Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Pennsylvania Society of Professional Engineers / PA Engineering Foundation
scholarships.description: $1,000 scholarships awarded to Pennsylvania high school graduating seniors who will pursue an engineering-related undergraduate degree at a Pennsylvania ABET-accredited engineering program.

scholarships.name: Terry Foundation Traditional Scholarship
scholarships.description: A full ride, last dollar scholarship covering up to eight semesters for Texas high school seniors who are nominated by one of eleven affiliated Texas public universities. Requires strong academics, leadership, financial need, and on-campus residency the first year.

scholarships.name: Greater Texas Foundation Scholars Program
scholarships.description: Provides up to $2,000 per year to graduating seniors from designated Texas Early College High Schools who continue to a four-year Texas university. Renewable while enrolled.

scholarships.name: Om & Shanti Scholarship
scholarships.description: Four-year awards of up to $6,000 per year for graduating seniors of a public high school in Dallas or Collin County, Texas. First-generation applicants receive preference when merit is equal.

scholarships.name: Dr. Frederick Jones Sr. Family Scholarship
scholarships.description: Awards up to $5,000 to graduating seniors from Southwest Dallas (Duncanville, DeSoto, Cedar Hill, and Lancaster) pursuing a degree in science, technology, engineering, mathematics, or medicine.

scholarships.name: Bear Bison Scholarship
scholarships.description: Covers up to the full amount of tuition for graduating seniors of South Oak Cliff High School or Sunset High School in Dallas pursuing a degree at any accredited college.

scholarships.name: TEXAS Grant (Toward EXcellence, Access, and Success)
scholarships.description: State need-based grant for Texas residents with financial need who enroll at least three-quarter time at a public university and have not earned a bachelor's degree. Award amount is set annually by the state and applied toward tuition and fees.

scholarships.name: Texas Tuition Equalization Grant (TEG)
scholarships.description: Need-based state grant for Texas residents with financial need who attend an approved private or independent Texas college or university and enroll at least three-quarter time.

scholarships.name: San Antonio Area Foundation Legacy Scholarship
scholarships.description: Awards $10,000 per academic year, renewable up to four years, to high school juniors living in and attending school in Bexar or Webb County who show leadership and community involvement and intend to enroll at a Texas college.

scholarships.name: Austin Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: A single application matches Central Texas students (Travis, Williamson, Hays, Caldwell, and Bastrop Counties) to more than 60 distinct scholarship funds for college or trade programs.

scholarships.name: Paso del Norte Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Multiple scholarship funds for graduating high school seniors, current college students, and nontraditional students in the El Paso region, covering tuition, books, and expenses. Applications run through the Scholarship360 platform.

scholarships.name: El Paso ISD Education Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: Awards up to $5,000 to graduating EPISD seniors who have attended an EPISD high school for the last two years and will enroll full time in fall 2026. Selection is based on academics, leadership, and community involvement.

scholarships.name: Dell Scholars Program
scholarships.description: Awards $20,000 plus ongoing support to students with financial need who participated in an approved Dell Foundation college readiness program, earned at least a 2.4 GPA, and are Pell-eligible. Based in Austin, Texas, with many participating Texas programs.

scholarships.name: Texas 4-H Opportunity Scholarship
scholarships.description: About 200 scholarships ranging from $1,000 to $16,000 for graduating Texas 4-H members attending a Texas college or university, including baccalaureate, technical, and Courageous Heart tracks.

scholarships.name: Texas Farm Bureau District Scholarship
scholarships.description: In each of the 13 Texas Farm Bureau districts, one graduating senior receives a $5,000 scholarship and three receive $3,000 scholarships. Applicants are typically from Farm Bureau member families.

scholarships.name: Texas Farm Bureau Young Farmer & Rancher High School Scholarship
scholarships.description: Each of the 13 Texas Farm Bureau districts awards one $1,500 scholarship to a graduating senior pursuing a degree in agriculture.

scholarships.name: Texas PTA High School Senior Scholarship
scholarships.description: Awards $1,000 to graduating Texas high school seniors enrolling full time in college or a technical institute. Applicant and campus must be current members of an Active-status Local PTA/PTSA.

scholarships.name: Texas Armed Services Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: Provides $30,000 per year (the greater of $30,000 or average state cost of attendance) to students in an undergraduate officer commissioning program such as ROTC. Students must be appointed by a Texas state legislator, the governor, or lieutenant governor.

scholarships.name: Texas Exes Scholarships (UT Austin)
scholarships.description: Chapter and entering-freshman scholarships for incoming University of Texas at Austin students, automatically matched by high school zip code, plus the full-ride merit Forty Acres Scholars Program.

scholarships.name: Texas Restaurant Foundation W. Price Jr. Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: Awards $1,000 scholarships to students graduating from Texas high school hospitality and culinary programs who plan to continue in the food service or hospitality industry.

scholarships.name: Texas FFA Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: More than 140 academic scholarships ranging from $2,000 to $20,000 for graduating Texas FFA seniors enrolling at a Texas institution. Requires a minimum 1000 SAT or 19 ACT and an interview.

scholarships.name: Coastal Bend Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: One free application considers graduating seniors and college students in the Coastal Bend (Corpus Christi region) for more than 100 scholarship funds. Applicants are notified by end of May.

scholarships.name: Texas Elks State Association Four-Year Scholarship
scholarships.description: Awards up to $1,250 to Texas high school seniors who plan to attend college in Texas. Open to graduating seniors who are U.S. citizens.

scholarships.name: Permian Basin Area Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Multiple scholarship funds for students originating from the Permian Basin region who will attend a Texas college full time, with several funds focused on STEM fields. One online application matches students to eligible awards.

scholarships.name: Amarillo Area Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: One online application matches Texas Panhandle students (graduating seniors, current college, and returning students) to county-specific, Panhandle-wide, and field-of-study scholarship funds.

scholarships.name: Texas and Southwestern Cattle Raisers Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Texas and Southwestern Cattle Raisers Foundation
scholarships.description: A $2,000 one-year award for students pursuing a degree in the field of agriculture. Number of awards depends on annual funding.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation of West Texas Scholarships
scholarships.description: More than 70 scholarship funds for students from the South Plains / Lubbock region, distributed through one application. The foundation awards several hundred thousand dollars in scholarships each year.

scholarships.name: North Texas Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Numerous scholarship funds for students in the Fort Worth region, many tied to specific high schools (such as Paschal, Southwest, and Amon Carter-Riverside), several renewable for multiple years.

scholarships.name: Raul Tijerina Jr. Foundation Far Horizons Scholarship
scholarships.description: Provides up to $3,000 toward tuition, books, and mandated fees for qualifying Rio Grande Valley high school graduates accepted at any accredited Texas college, university, or vocational school.

scholarships.name: VAMOS Scholarships
scholarships.organization: Valley Alliance of Mentors for Opportunities and Scholarships (VAMOS)
scholarships.description: Scholarships for graduating high school seniors in the Rio Grande Valley, supporting college enrollment for local students. Applications are due in early April.

scholarships.name: Greater Houston Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Scholarship funds for graduating seniors from public high schools in the Greater Houston area (Harris, Fort Bend, and Montgomery Counties), supporting students who show dedication, need, and community involvement.

scholarships.name: LULAC National Scholarship Fund
scholarships.description: Awards of $250 to $2,000 (National Scholastic Achievement, Honors, and General awards) administered through participating local LULAC councils, many across Texas. Applicants must apply through a council near where they live or study.

scholarships.name: Hispanic Scholarship Fund (HSF) Scholarship
scholarships.description: Need-based awards of $500 to $5,000 for students of Hispanic heritage planning full-time enrollment at an accredited nonprofit U.S. university or graduate school. A large share of recipients are Texas students.

scholarships.name: Jack Kent Cooke Foundation College Scholarship
scholarships.description: Provides up to $55,000 per year for high-achieving high school seniors with financial need to attend a four-year college. Texas seniors are eligible and regularly named as recipients.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation for the Texas Hill Country Scholarships
scholarships.organization: Community Foundation for the Texas Hill Country
scholarships.description: Academic scholarships in fields including business, nursing, agriculture, medicine, and music for graduating high school students and graduates of Bandera, Kendall, and Kerr Counties in the Texas Hill Country.

scholarships.name: Dallas College Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: More than 300 scholarship opportunities each year for Dallas College students, awarded through one application. Priority fall deadline is April 30 with later final deadlines.

scholarships.name: McLennan Community College Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Annual scholarship competition for McLennan Community College students and incoming students from the Waco / McLennan County area, awarded through one online application with fall and spring cycles.

scholarships.name: UTRGV Entering Freshman Scholarships
scholarships.organization: University of Texas Rio Grande Valley
scholarships.description: Merit-based scholarships for admitted entering freshmen at UT Rio Grande Valley, awarded based on academic record. Many serve Rio Grande Valley and Texas residents.

scholarships.name: Texas Educational Opportunity Grant (TEOG)
scholarships.description: Need-based state grant for Texas residents with financial need enrolling at least half time at a Texas public two-year college (community, technical, or state college). Applied toward tuition and fees.

scholarships.name: Institute of Hispanic Culture of Houston Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Institute of Hispanic Culture of Houston
scholarships.description: Scholarships for Houston-area students of Hispanic heritage pursuing higher education, awarded by the Institute of Hispanic Culture of Houston to support Latino students in the region.

scholarships.name: The Dallas Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: Individual scholarship funds administered by The Dallas Foundation for students in the Dallas area, opening February 1 with deadlines in spring. Each fund carries its own eligibility criteria.

scholarships.name: HOPE Scholarship
scholarships.amountLabel: Partial tuition, per credit hour rate set annually
scholarships.description: Merit award for Georgia residents who graduate high school with a 3.0 HOPE GPA and attend an eligible Georgia public or private college. Funded by the Georgia Lottery and pays a set amount per credit hour toward tuition. Students must maintain a 3.0 college GPA to keep it.

scholarships.name: Zell Miller Scholarship
scholarships.amountLabel: Full standard tuition at eligible Georgia institutions
scholarships.description: Top tier of Georgia's HOPE program for high achievers. Requires a 3.7 high school GPA plus a minimum 1200 SAT or 26 ACT (or graduating as valedictorian or salutatorian). Covers full standard tuition at eligible Georgia public colleges. Students must keep a 3.3 college GPA.

scholarships.name: HOPE Grant
scholarships.amountLabel: Partial tuition toward certificate or diploma programs
scholarships.description: Helps Georgia residents pay tuition in a certificate or diploma program at a Georgia public technical college or university, regardless of high school GPA. Lottery funded and not based on financial need. Pays a set per credit hour amount toward tuition.

scholarships.name: HOPE Career Grant
scholarships.amountLabel: Added tuition help in high-demand career fields
scholarships.description: Additional grant stacked on top of the HOPE Grant for Georgia technical college students enrolled in specific high-demand fields such as welding, healthcare, commercial truck driving, and computer technology. Helps cover remaining tuition costs.

scholarships.name: Zell Miller Grant
scholarships.amountLabel: Full standard tuition for eligible technical programs
scholarships.description: Grant covering 100 percent of standard tuition at a Georgia public technical college for students in an eligible certificate or diploma program who maintain at least a 3.5 cumulative postsecondary GPA. No high school GPA requirement to start.

scholarships.name: Georgia Tuition Equalization Grant
scholarships.description: Non-need grant for Georgia residents enrolled full time in an undergraduate degree program at an eligible private college in Georgia. Helps offset the tuition gap between public and private schools. Award amount is set annually by the state legislature.

scholarships.name: Georgia HERO Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for members of the Georgia National Guard and U.S. Military Reserves who served in a combat zone, and for their children and spouses. Children must be age 25 or younger during the qualifying service term and attend an eligible Georgia college.

scholarships.name: Georgia Public Safety Memorial Grant
scholarships.amountLabel: Cost of attendance for dependents of fallen or disabled officers
scholarships.description: Grant for the dependent children of Georgia public safety officers (law enforcement, firefighters, EMTs, paramedics, HERO operators, prison guards) who were permanently disabled or killed in the line of duty. Recipients must be full-time Georgia college students.

scholarships.name: REACH Georgia Scholarship
scholarships.description: Needs-based mentoring and scholarship program. Students are selected as rising 8th graders in participating districts and, if they meet academic, behavior, and attendance benchmarks through high school, earn up to $10,000 toward a HOPE-eligible Georgia college. Special consideration for first-generation students.

scholarships.name: Community Foundation for Greater Atlanta Scholarships
scholarships.amountLabel: Varies by fund; hundreds of awards
scholarships.description: A single universal application matches metro Atlanta students to hundreds of donor scholarship funds. Many are targeted to a specific school, county, course of study, or background, and many are renewable. Open to graduating seniors and some current college students.

scholarships.name: North Georgia Community Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.description: A common scholarship application on the foundation's portal matches North Georgia students to many donor-established funds with varying eligibility and award sizes. The 2027 cycle typically opens in mid-January with a March 2 deadline.

scholarships.name: Cobb EMC Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: Awards fourteen $5,000 scholarships each year to high school seniors whose primary residence is served by Cobb EMC. Selection weighs academics, community involvement, leadership, and character. Winners may attend any accredited two- or four-year or vocational school in Georgia.

scholarships.name: Judge Phyllis Kravitch Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for Chatham County resident students who are rising second or third year law students. Administered by the Savannah Community Foundation among its portfolio of donor-established scholarships.

scholarships.name: Doris Dorsey Jones Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for graduating high school seniors who are residents of Bryan, Chatham, or Effingham Counties in coastal Georgia. Administered by the Savannah Community Foundation.

scholarships.name: Honorable Eugene Gadsden Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.amountLabel: $1,000 per year for up to four years
scholarships.description: Renewable award for graduating seniors from Chatham County high schools, providing $1,000 per year for up to four years of college. Administered by the Savannah Community Foundation.

scholarships.name: Kiwanis Memorial Educational Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for graduating seniors from Chatham County high schools, awarded through the Savannah Community Foundation on behalf of the Kiwanis Memorial Educational Foundation.

scholarships.name: St. Francis Turner Hathaway Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for graduating seniors from Chatham County high schools, administered by the Savannah Community Foundation.

scholarships.name: Rev. Bennie R. Mitchell Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for graduating seniors in the Savannah-Chatham County Public School System, awarded through the Savannah Community Foundation.

scholarships.name: Boasso America Community Enrichment Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for graduating seniors at Robert Groves High School in Garden City, Georgia. Administered by the Savannah Community Foundation.

scholarships.name: Gaskins Environmental Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for high school seniors or college students from South Georgia with at least a 2.5 GPA who intend to major in environmental science. Selection considers academics, leadership, service, and financial need.

scholarships.name: James D. Eunice Legacy Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for high school seniors from South Georgia within the foundation's service area who have at least a 2.5 GPA. Selection weighs academics, leadership, extracurricular activities, character, and community service.

scholarships.name: Mitchell EMC Operation Round Up Scholarship
scholarships.description: Need-conscious award for high school seniors or college students with at least a 2.5 GPA whose primary residence is in the Mitchell EMC service area. Preference to Mitchell EMC consumers. Considers financial need, academics, and service.

scholarships.name: Moultrie-Colquitt County High School Alumni Scholarship
scholarships.description: Merit award for Colquitt County High School seniors with at least a 3.5 GPA and a 1050 SAT or 20 ACT who plan to attend one of the top University System of Georgia institutions.

scholarships.name: Georgia Dental Hygienists' Association Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for dental hygiene students or registered dental hygienists enrolled in an accredited Georgia program with at least a 3.0 GPA who intend to practice in Georgia for at least two years.

scholarships.name: Geraldine Grant Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for graduating seniors at Valdosta public high schools with at least a 3.0 GPA. Special consideration goes to underrepresented minority students and to those majoring in business, accounting, or finance.

scholarships.name: Homer E. Breckenridge Jr. Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for Seminole County High School seniors in Donalsonville with at least a 3.0 GPA who intend to major in a medical field.

scholarships.name: Terri Matthews Nursing Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for Thomas County high school seniors (Thomasville High, Thomas County Central, or Brookwood School) planning to major in nursing, or for current nursing program students.

scholarships.name: Benjamin E. Gordon Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for Valdosta High School seniors in Lowndes County with at least a 2.7 GPA. Administered by the Community Foundation of South Georgia.

scholarships.name: Harrison Hooks Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for Thomas County high school seniors with at least a 3.0 GPA who plan to enroll at a Georgia college or university.

scholarships.name: Alan George Memorial YMCA Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for Thomas County high school seniors with at least a 3.0 GPA who are affiliated with the Thomasville YMCA. Administered by the Community Foundation of South Georgia.

scholarships.name: Wyatt Hutchins Alexander Family Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for Early County High School seniors in Blakely with at least a 3.5 GPA (or 3.0 under unusual circumstances). Administered by the Community Foundation of South Georgia.

scholarships.name: C. M. and Bernice C. Stripling UGA Forestry Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for Georgia high school graduates in the top academic half of their class who enroll in the University of Georgia School of Forest Resources and maintain at least a 3.0 college GPA.

scholarships.name: Latin American Association-Mohawk Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship funded by the Latin American Association and Mohawk Industries for students involved in the Hispanic community who graduated from eligible high schools in Chattooga, Floyd, Gordon, Murray, or Whitfield Counties. Applied toward tuition and fees at Georgia Northwestern Technical College.

scholarships.name: Steen Miles Journalism/Communications Scholarship
scholarships.description: One-time $4,000 award from the Atlanta Association of Black Journalists for students pursuing degrees in journalism or communications (broadcast, radio, print, or digital media). Winner also receives a one-year AABJ membership.

scholarships.name: 100 Black Men of America National Scholarship
scholarships.description: National scholarship for graduating high school seniors or full-time college undergraduates who are 100 Black Men mentees, Collegiate 100 members, or affiliates. Headquartered in Atlanta. Awards range from $1,000 to $5,000 toward tuition, room, board, and books.

scholarships.name: Illinois Monetary Award Program (MAP) Grant
scholarships.description: Need based state grant for Illinois residents attending approved Illinois colleges. Awarded automatically when a student lists Illinois residency on the FAFSA. Does not need to be repaid and applies toward tuition and mandatory fees.

scholarships.name: Illinois Veteran Grant (IVG)
scholarships.description: Entitlement grant that pays tuition and mandatory fees at Illinois public colleges and universities for eligible Illinois veterans. Covers up to the equivalent of four years of full time enrollment. One application establishes eligibility.

scholarships.name: Illinois National Guard (ING) Grant
scholarships.description: Grant that pays tuition and certain fees at Illinois public colleges and universities for active members of the Illinois National Guard. Available for undergraduate or graduate study at approved Illinois institutions.

scholarships.name: Grant Program for Dependents of Police or Fire Officers
scholarships.description: Provides tuition and mandatory fee assistance for the spouse or child of an Illinois police or fire officer who was killed or at least 90 percent disabled in the line of duty. Good for undergraduate or graduate study at ISAC approved Illinois colleges.

scholarships.name: Golden Apple Scholars of Illinois
scholarships.organization: Golden Apple Foundation / Illinois Student Assistance Commission
scholarships.description: Program for Illinois high school seniors and early college students committed to teaching. Provides tuition assistance, summer institutes and mentoring in exchange for teaching five years in an Illinois school of need after earning licensure.

scholarships.name: Teachers of Illinois Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: State scholarship for students pursuing teaching careers who commit to teaching in Illinois. Replaced the former Minority Teachers of Illinois program and supports tuition and fees at approved Illinois institutions.

scholarships.name: Nursing Education Scholarship Program (NES)
scholarships.description: Scholarship for Illinois residents pursuing practical nursing, associate, diploma, bachelor or graduate nursing degrees who demonstrate the greatest financial need. Supports tuition, fees and related costs.

scholarships.name: CPS Dream Fund Scholarship
scholarships.description: Renewable last dollar scholarship for need based undocumented Chicago Public Schools students pursuing postsecondary education. Renewable for up to six years and requires a grade point average of 2.0 or higher.

scholarships.name: ILLCF Soy El Futuro Scholarship and Leadership Program
